author: noampo62215e8aef
excerpt: A Microsoft-signed Windows Defender kernel driver (KslD.sys) exposes unrestricted physical memory read primitives, enabling KASLR bypass, PPL-protected LSASS credential dumping, and EDR evasion—without loading any external driver.
title: KslD.sys – Weaponizing Windows Defender’s Own Signed Driver

author: Yehuda Smirnov
excerpt: We show a Cross-Tenant ROPC issue that evades Conditional Access Policies. Attackers can successfully authenticate and generate "Success" logs without triggering MFA, though the resulting token grants no actual access to resources.
title: Evading EntraID Conditional Access Policies via Cross-Tenant ROPC

author: Yehuda Smirnov
excerpt: What happens when you skip memory allocation, skip writing, and weaponize thread context alone? This post explores a new class of process injection that lives entirely in the execution layer — no alloc, no write, just a well-placed hijack.
title: New Process Injection Class: The CONTEXT-Only Attack Surface

author: Yehuda Smirnov
excerpt: ShareFiltrator is a Python tool designed for enumerating and bulk downloading sensitive files from SharePoint and OneDrive using authenticated cookies. author: Yehuda Smirnov
excerpt: ShadowHound is a PowerShell tool designed for mapping Active Directory environments without using known malicious binaries. It utilizes legitimate PowerShell modules for data collection through two methods: ADWS and LDAP.
title: ShadowHound: A SharpHound Alternative Using Native PowerShell

author: Yehuda Smirnov

We also introduce SharpExclusionFinder, a C# tool for automating exclusion discovery, and provide tips for defenders to monitor and mitigate…
title: Peeking Behind the Curtain: Finding Defender’s Exclusions

author: Yehuda Smirnov
excerpt: In this article, we will go over the WMI technology, the potential attack vectors it opens, some detection pitfalls (from an attacker’s perspective), and how we can enumerate the technology for useful capabilities. We will close up with an example of escalating a remote registry write primitive…
title: WMI Research and Lateral Movement
